MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL on the supplied regime reading, with normal 20-day XU100 volatility at 29.1% and breadth at 0/8 sectors positive. Participation is exceptionally weak; all sectors posted negative 1W returns.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Holding & Investment led on a relative basis at 1W: -2.53% and 1M: -9.45%, followed by Retail & Food at -3.24% and -9.66%. HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) is RECOVERY, as is SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom was weakest at 1W: -13.92% and 1M: -23.26%; Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry also underperformed, down 10.21% and 8.49% respectively over 1W. KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%) and GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%) are BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
The five strongest relative performers were HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%), RECOVERY; SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), RECOVERY; SOKM (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.17%), BELOW TREND; ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%), BELOW TREND; and TAVHL (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -2.57%), BELOW TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
The weakest five were KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%), BELOW TREND; GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%), BELOW TREND; VESTL (1W: -19.50% | 1M: -38.34%), BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -14.08% | 1M: -25.34%), BELOW TREND; and HEKTS (1W: -13.79% | 1M: -18.98%), BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The only positive 1W moves among the reported leaders were HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%), RECOVERY, and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), RECOVERY. Downside momentum was sharpest in KONTR (1W: -25.29% | 1M: -44.78%), BELOW TREND.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance fell 4.20% over 1W and 7.65% over 1M, with no broad sector confirmation. HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%) is RECOVERY, while AKBNK (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -10.33%) and GARAN (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -2.24%) remain BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry was weak, down 8.49% over 1W and 19.05% over 1M. ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%) is a relative holdout but remains BELOW TREND; EREGL (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.71%) and FROTO (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -15.96%) are also BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals was among the weakest sectors, down 10.21% over 1W and 19.76% over 1M. TUPRS (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -10.60%) is BELOW TREND; TRALT (1W: -12.98% | 1M: -24.89%) and GUBRF (1W: -19.92% | 1M: -29.85%) show deeper weakness, both BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay defensive and emphasize capital preservation; 0/8 positive sectors and broadly negative stock trends argue against aggressive dip-buying. Keep risk measured and wait for breadth improvement and sustained RECOVERY signals before adding exposure.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%), RECOVERY, and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), RECOVERY, for follow-through. Also monitor ASELS (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -8.09%), BELOW TREND, and TUPRS (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -10.60%), BELOW TREND, for signs that selling pressure is easing.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Banking & Finance for any expansion beyond the isolated rebound and Retail & Food for stabilization after comparatively smaller losses. Technology & Telecom remains the key downside-risk area after the steepest sector declines.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Specific XU100 support and resistance levels were not provided, so no price levels can be stated reliably. Key triggers are a turn to positive sector breadth and volatility moving below 25%; renewed losses alongside volatility above 40% would strengthen the risk-off signal.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The supplied regime is NEUTRAL, but normal volatility of 29.1% sits against notably weak breadth: no sector gained over 1W. Relative opportunities are limited to early rebounds in HALKB (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -4.65%), RECOVERY, and SAHOL (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.36%), RECOVERY; persistent sector-wide weakness remains the primary risk.
